fact: At the Cyber Africa Forum of 24-25 June 2025 ASIN signed agreements to consolidate its role as National Root Certification Authority and to widen electronic trust services (electronic signature, digital identity, electronic seal), and an MoU on integration into Benin's national Public Key Infrastructure.
title: L'ASIN signe plusieurs accords de partenariat pour accélérer la transformation numérique du Bénin
publisher: Agence des Systèmes d'Information et du Numérique (ASIN)
